title: copilot repair --json
description: Result of a layer-role-split repair: org/dept/foundation mirrors get fetch+reset --hard/reclone; the personal layer gets stash-and-flag (never discard).
$comment: IMPORTANT: cli-contract.md does NOT specify a --json shape for `repair` (the verb is consumed and participates in flock serialization, but no payload is enumerated). This schema is a defensible reconstruction from architecture.md/ecosystem-architecture.md §5.2 repair semantics (A-H11: mirrors reset/reclone, personal stash-and-flag-never-discard). additionalProperties is left true and this file MUST be tightened/frozen once the CLI publishes repair's real payload.

result.$comment: Value set unspecified in the contract; left as a non-empty string.

role.$comment: Reconstructed role split (mirror vs personal vs foundation) from the split-by-layer-role repair design; not an enumerated field in cli-contract.md.

op.$comment: Reconstructed op set: mirrors reset/reclone, personal stash-flag (never discard), else unchanged. Not enumerated in cli-contract.md.

retained_dirty.description: Human-owned/dirty trees that were preserved (never-destroy invariant #3). Mirrors deprovision.retained_dirty.
